corrections.reason: The printed glyph has the 2nd-order ಕಾዕብ stroke (ኑ) forming the interrogative particle ታንቆኑ ('is it by hanging himself that he will die?'), translating Ge'ez ይቀትልኑ እንጋ ርእሶ.
Visually and philologically the word is ባታምኑ ('if you do not believe'), translating the preceding Ge'ez ለእመ ኢአመንክሙ; ባታ was misread as በቃ due to ink bleed on the crossbars.
The printed word is ያነ (archaic/Andemta demonstrative 'that thing [which I teach]'), with a plain 1st-order ነ rather than ኑ.
The initial character is 6th-order እ (እንዳይደለ, 'that it is not'), misread as 1st-order አ.
